items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: Basil Rathbone was the waiter; that's the way they did it.

ctx.x: One of the nicest things that happened to me there was my favorite move star called up and left a message--I wasn't there, that afternoon she called up, Bette Davis, and asked me if

I would play out in Hollywood Canteen. She was in charge of the entertainment out in the Hollywood Canteen and I went down on two occasions. On this particular occasion, Basil Rathbone was the waiter; that's the way they did it.
The women all danced with the soldiers.
